BiblicalUsage: Firstfruits is the first of the crop, brought to God before any of it is eaten. Exodus 23:19 commands the first of the firstfruits to be brought into the house of the Lord, Exodus 34:22 ties it to the feast of weeks, Leviticus 23:17 describes the two wave loaves baked with leaven, and Nehemiah 10:35 shows the returned exiles promising to bring the firstfruits of their ground year by year.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe firstfruits is the whole gospel of giving in one word: God gets the first, not the leftover, because the first belongs to him and the rest is blessed by it.
